html:
G'oya

Bitta GROUP BY city ichida ikki xil sanoq kerak: hamma buyurtmalar va faqat bekor qilinganlari. Ikkinchisi uchun WHERE ishlatib bo'lmaydi, u birinchisini ham kesadi. Shartli yig'indi SUM(CASE ...) ikkalasini bir o'tishda beradi.

Yechim

SELECT city,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS cancel_pct
FROM orders
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city

100.0 dagi nuqta tasodifiy emas: u bo'lishni kasr songa aylantiradi.

Tuzoqlar

Ikkala bazada ham butun sonni butun songa bo'lish butun son beradi. Toshkentda 4 tadan 2 tasi bekor, bu 50 foiz va to'g'ri chiqadi. Lekin 6 tadan 1 tasi 16.7 emas, 16 bo'lib qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT city,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
       100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS cancel_pct
FROM orders
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city

COUNT(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ham ko'p uchraydigan xato. COUNT qiymatni emas, NULL bo'lmagan qatorlarni sanaydi, 0 esa NULL emas. COUNT bilan yozmoqchi bo'lsangiz, ELSE qismini olib tashlang.

Boshqa yo'l

0 va 1 dan iborat ustunning o'rtachasi birlar ulushiga teng:

SELECT city,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled,
       ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS cancel_pct
FROM orders
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city
